content.sanskrit:
सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते ।
अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद् व्रतं मम ॥
content.transliteration:
sakṛdeva prapannāya tavāsmīti ca yācate |
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo dadāmyetad vrataṃ mama ||
content.translation: To anyone who surrenders to me even once and declares 'I am yours', I grant freedom from fear to all beings. This is my solemn vow.
content.sanskrit_source: Ancient Valmiki verse text; digital transcription cross-checked against valmikiramayan.net.

content.sanskrit:
आनयैनं हरिश्रेष्ठ दत्तमस्याभयं मया ।
विभीषणो वा सुग्रीव यदि वा रावणः स्वयं ॥
content.transliteration:
ānayainaṃ hariśreṣṭha dattamasyābhayaṃ mayā |
vibhīṣaṇo vā sugrīva yadi vā rāvaṇaḥ svayam ||
content.translation: Bring him here, O foremost among monkeys; sanctuary has been granted by me to him, whether he be Vibhishana or Ravana himself!
content.sanskrit_source: Ancient Valmiki verse text; digital transcription cross-checked against valmikiramayan.net.
